description: 津波一時緊急避難場所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and tsunami] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 那覇市. 那覇市の津波一時緊急避難場所の一覧です。. Coverage: 那覇市. The portal files it under the publisher 那覇市. Its tags are 一時避難場所, 指定緊急避難場所, 津波避難ビル, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-02-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
